title: LShiftRow
html:
定义组：指标替换与规约。有序参数：z867、z868、z869。

把指标 >=c 提升 d；仅进入项绑定时截止值加一。：单行局部条件。

规范公式

(@ LShiftRow z867 z868 z869) 按 无捕获缩写规则 展开为下列有限公式。参数只取集合，不能填入函数项或元语言公式。

(exists c
  (exists d
    (exists t
      (exists u
        (and
          (exists z872 (and (exists z873 (and (@ Pair t u z873) (@ Pair d z873 z872))) (@ Pair c z872 z869)))
          (and
            (@ Nat c)
            (and
              (@ Nat d)
              (and
                (@ AnyRaw t)
                (or
                  (exists z874
                    (and
                      (@ TVar z874 t)
                      (or
                        (and (in z874 c) (= u t))
                        (exists z875 (and (or (= z874 c) (in c z874)) (and (@ Add z874 d z875) (@ TVar z875 u)))))))
                  (or
                    (exists z874 (and (@ TConst z874 t) (= t u)))
                    (or
                      (exists z877
                        (exists z878
                          (exists z883
                            (and
                            (@ ULam z877 t)
                            (and
                            (@ ULam z878 u)
                            (and
                            (@ Succ c z883)
                            (exists z884
                            (exists z885
                            (and
                            (in z884 z868)
                            (and
                            (@ App z867 z884 z885)
                            (exists z886
                            (and (exists z887 (and (@ Pair z877 z878 z887) (@ Pair d z887 z886))) (@ Pair z883 z886 z885)))))))))))))
                      (or
                        (exists z876
                          (exists z877
                            (exists z878
                            (exists z883
                            (and
                            (@ TLam z876 z877 t)
                            (and
                            (@ TLam z876 z878 u)
                            (and
                            (@ Succ c z883)
                            (exists z888
                            (exists z889
                            (and
                            (in z888 z868)
                            (and
                            (@ App z867 z888 z889)
                            (exists z890
                            (and (exists z891 (and (@ Pair z877 z878 z891) (@ Pair d z891 z890))) (@ Pair z883 z890 z889))))))))))))))
                        (exists z879
                          (exists z880
                            (exists z881
                            (exists z882
                            (and
                            (@ TApp z879 z880 t)
                            (and
                            (@ TApp z881 z882 u)
                            (and
                            (exists z892
                            (exists z893
                            (and
                            (in z892 z868)
                            (and
                            (@ App z867 z892 z893)
                            (exists z894
                            (and (exists z895 (and (@ Pair z879 z881 z895) (@ Pair d z895 z894))) (@ Pair c z894 z893)))))))
                            (exists z896
                            (exists z897
                            (and
                            (in z896 z868)
                            (and
                            (@ App z867 z896 z897)
                            (exists z898
                            (and (exists z899 (and (@ Pair z880 z882 z899) (@ Pair d z899 z898))) (@ Pair c z898 z897))))))))))))))))))))))))))
